note: The authoritative list of engineering commands for this repository.
docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md. The release gate is the source of truth for what must
pass; where a local command differs from the gate, 'ci_equivalent' records the
gate's own wording so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.
scripts/check_oi_command_catalog.py fails if a gate step is missing from here.
safe_local        - reads or checks only. No paid call, no service, no state change.
test_only         - runs against a local or throwaway database. Changes local state.
credentialed_paid - makes real calls to a paid provider. Never run without a reason.
staging_only      - points at a deployed non-production environment.
production        - operator action. The engineering assistant never runs these.

commands.notes: The release gate lints the whole repository, not only src/tests/scripts.
